title: Identify the top 5 German drivers who recorded the fastest qualifying times
question: Identify the top 5 German drivers who recorded the fastest qualifying times (Q3) in races held between 2010 and 2020. For each driver, return their full name, nationality, and the number of such qualifying appearances.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    COUNT(q.XCL_056) AS qualifying_appearances
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN qualifying AS q ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058
JOIN races AS r ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
  AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020
  AND q.XCL_064 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041
ORDER BY MIN(q.XCL_064) ASC
LIMIT 5
